description: React component implementing the main application shell for a healthcare appointment booking system, including navigation and step management.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React component managing the appointment booking flow with various steps.

methods.name: resetToStart
methods.description: Resets the entire booking process to the initial state.

methods.name: onSelectDoctor
methods.description: Sets the selected doctor and proceeds to the slot selection step.

methods.name: onNextFromSlots
methods.description: Proceeds to the patient info step if a slot is selected.

methods.name: onSubmitPatient
methods.description: Stores patient information and moves to confirmation step.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Generates a mock reference and advances to success screen.
